name: Math O' Lantern: Jump & Count-Up
domain: Subtraction by Counting Up on a Number Line
competency: Understanding subtraction as the distance between two numbers by hopping along friendly benchmark milestones (friendly tens and hundreds)
ncertStandard: Grade 2 & 3 Mathematics: Joyful Mathematics Chapter 6 (Fun with Give and Take - Jump Strategy)
overview: Children help Jugnu the glowing firefly hop forward from the smaller number to the bigger destination along a glowing lantern trail. By making easy hops to friendly tens and hundreds, children discover that adding the hops together gives the exact subtraction answer without confusing borrowing.
learningOutcomes: Understand subtraction as forward distance on a number line
Identify and hop to nearest friendly benchmark numbers (e.g. 14 -> 20 -> 50)
Combine unit hops and ten hops to calculate multi-digit differences mentally
Connect hop additions (+6 and +30) with the subtraction equation (50 - 14 = 36)
Freely explore jump combinations in the interactive Sandbox mode

levels.name: Firefly Hops (Within 30)
levels.description: Gentle introduction: hop to friendly 20 or 30 with numbers up to 30

levels.name: Friendly Tens Trail (Within 60)
levels.description: Two-hop journey: units to friendly 10, then tens to target (e.g. 36 -> 40 -> 50)

levels.name: Century Leap (To 100)
levels.description: Hop to friendly ten, then leap to 100 (e.g. 64 -> 70 -> 100)
